metadata.description: Claude Code mods and skills: a Domino's-style order tracker for Claude, starring Clawd.

plugins.name: clawd-tracker
plugins.description: Mod: a pizza-tracker progress bar above the prompt. Clawd acts out what Claude is doing, with an honest progress bar, a learned ETA, a delivery receipt and ding, plan usage and four themes.

plugins.name: clawd-arcade
plugins.description: Mod: Clawd-themed games in a side pane while Claude works. Pauses when Claude needs you and tells you when the order's up.
